description: The reporter's scratch app, showing the defect end to end. The Markup panel holds the line that was typed, three colour tags opened one inside the other and closed one at a time around three letters. The Output panel shows all three letters rendered in the same colour, the one from the outermost tag, instead of one colour each. The Spans panel shows the three styled ranges that were computed: all three start at offset 0 and each is wider than the one before it, listed narrowest first, so the widest is layered last and covers the other two. The ranges themselves are right and only their order is wrong, which is the whole diagnosis and is visible nowhere but here.
